title: SUTI Message Schema
description: JSON Schema for SUTI (Standardized Utilization of Transport Information) messages. Version 2026 draft.

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema for validation

sutiMessages.description: Array of complete SUTI messages for batch transmission

msgTypeEnum.description: Valid SUTI message type codes (centralized for reuse)

msg.description: Common message header for all SUTI messages

msgTimeStamp.description: Timestamp when the message was created

id.description: Generic identifier with source and value

unique.description: Whether this identifier is globally unique

referenceToMsg.description: Reference to another message (must have at least one identifier)

zone.description: Description of a geographic area agreed between client and provider

node.description: A point in a route (pickup, destination, etc.)

resourceDispatch.description: Resource dispatch information for vehicle login/logout

idMsgRef.description: Reference to a specific message with message metadata

idOrderForwardRef.description: References used when an order is forwarded
